name: Libido 7
source:
The main character of this game is a young girl Naru. She's trained in sisterly love by her sister. Game consists of short episodes about Naru and her friends.

[From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=265&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
translation:
本作的主角是一位名叫奈留的少女。她在姊姊的指導下學習姊妹之愛。遊戲由關於奈留和她的朋友們的短篇故事組成。

［引自[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=265&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]］
